overview.en:
Search Coinbase Developer Platform documentation for wallet and payment integrations.

Use official developer documentation to plan wallet or payment integrations. Provide the SDK language and target flow, then connect implementation steps to their source references.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
检索 Coinbase 开发者平台文档，辅助钱包与支付集成开发。

根据官方开发文档规划钱包或支付集成。提供 SDK 语言和目标流程后，将实现步骤与文档依据对应起来。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。
